'''Herman Johan Christiaan Berendsen''' (22 September 1934 – 7 October 2019) was a Dutch chemist. He was a professor of [[physical chemistry]] at the [[University of Groningen]] from 1967 to 1999.

==Career==
Berendsen was born on 22 September 1934 in [[Apeldoorn]].<ref name=rug>{{cite web|url=https://hoogleraren.ub.rug.nl/hoogleraren/157-berendsen-herman-johan-christiaan |title=Herman Johan Christiaan Berendsen (1934) |publisher=University of Groningen |date= |accessdate=25 April 2016}}</ref> After high school he studied maths and physics at [[Utrecht University]], obtaining a degree in 1957. In 1962, he obtained his PhD ''cum laude'' under Jan Kommandeur from the University of Groningen, with a dissertation titled: "An NMR study of collagen hydration".<ref name="chv">{{cite web|url=https://chg.kncv.nl/geschiedenis/biografieen/b/berendsen%2C-h.j.c. |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241203153149/https://chg.kncv.nl/geschiedenis/biografieen/b/berendsen%2C-h.j.c. |title=Berendsen, H.J.C. |language=nl |publisher=Chemie Historische Groep |date= |archive-date=3 December 2024}}</ref> In March 1963, Berendsen was appointed lector of physical chemistry at his ''alma mater'', and four years later became full professor. He retired in 1999.<ref name=rug/> At Groningen, Berendsen was group leader of [[molecular dynamics]].<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.rug.nl/news/2013/06/berni-alder-prijs |title=Berni J. Alder Award for Herman Berendsen |publisher=University of Groningen |date=12 June 2013 |accessdate=25 April 2016}}</ref>

In 1976, Berendsen and [[Wilfred van Gunsteren]] together with the 2013 [[Nobel Prize in Chemistry]] winners [[Martin Karplus]] and [[Michael Levitt (biophysicist)|Michael Levitt]] were involved in the start of theories on [[Molecular mechanics|molecular calculating]].<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.nu.nl/wetenschap/3597218/nobelprijs-scheikunde-karplus-levitt-en-washel.html |title=Nobelprijs voor Scheikunde naar Karplus, Levitt en Washel |publisher=NU.nl |date=9 October 2013 |accessdate=25 April 2016}}</ref>

Berendsen was elected a member of the [[Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences]] in 1979.<ref>{{cite web|author= |url=https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3858 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160425203304/https://www.knaw.nl/en/members/members/3858 |title=Herman Berendsen |publisher=Royal Netherlands Academy of Arts and Sciences |date= |archive-date=25 April 2016 |accessdate=25 April 2016}}</ref> In 2013 he was awarded the [[Berni Alder|Berni J. Alder]] Prize by the [[Centre européen de calcul atomique et moléculaire]]. The jury amongst other points praised his development of the GROningen MOlecular Simulation ([[GROMOS]]) type of [[Force field (chemistry)|force field]].<ref>{{cite web|author=|url=https://www.cecam.org/berni-j-alder-cecam-prize/|title=Berni J. Alder CECAM Prize|publisher=Centre européen de calcul atomique et moléculaire|date=|accessdate=25 April 2016|archive-date=14 April 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190414055612/https://www.cecam.org/berni-j-alder-cecam-prize/|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Berendsen died on 7 October 2019 in [[Zuidhorn]].<ref name="chv"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rug.nl/research/molecular-dynamics/newsarticles/in-memoriam-herman-berendsen|title=In memoriam Herman Berendsen {{!}} Molecular Dynamics Group {{!}} Research {{!}} University of Groningen|website=www.rug.nl|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191011091750/https://www.rug.nl/research/molecular-dynamics/newsarticles/in-memoriam-herman-berendsen|date=9 October 2019|archive-date=11 October 2019}}</ref>
